review_gate_requirements.name: Full Proof Lineage Traceability
review_gate_requirements.condition: All proof-supporting artifacts from MPF-PF-009 through MPF-PF-020 must be present and cross-linked.

review_gate_requirements.name: Restricted Scope Enforcement
review_gate_requirements.condition: All theorem-facing language must explicitly preserve STRICTLY_LOCAL_RESTRICTED_DOMAIN scope.

review_gate_requirements.name: Failure Preservation Enforcement
review_gate_requirements.condition: All blockers, excluded domains, and counterexample classes must remain active and unresolved.

review_gate_requirements.name: Operator Integrity Verification
review_gate_requirements.condition: No operator typing drift or unauthorized composition expansion may exist.

review_gate_requirements.name: Non-Promotion Enforcement
review_gate_requirements.condition: Review readiness must not be interpreted as theorem proof or global closure.

review_gate_outputs.meaning: The restricted-local theorem candidate may enter formal TS4 review.
Review allowed, but unresolved blockers must remain attached to all theorem-facing artifacts.
Review delayed due to unresolved traceability, typing, or governance inconsistencies.
